cards.excerpt: A high-performing B2B sponsored LinkedIn post follows a hook-story-resolution-CTA structure and reads like a recommendation, not an ad. Here's the anatomy, the anti-patterns, and two example structures.
cards.author: Alexis Jarre

cards.title: LinkedIn Ads vs creator-led growth: an honest CPL framework
cards.excerpt: Compare LinkedIn Ads and sponsored creator posts with the same lead definition, attribution window and pipeline cohort. Naano uses creator-set fixed post prices, not click pricing.
cards.author: Thomas Marcelle

cards.title: How LinkedIn's algorithm rewards creators over brands in 2026
cards.excerpt: LinkedIn's algorithm distributes personal-account content to 3–5× more impressions than equivalent company-page posts. Here's the engineering reason, the 2024–2026 changes that widened the gap, and how B2B brands work with it instead of against it.
cards.author: Justine Namour

cards.title: Naano vs alternatives : la marketplace de créateurs B2B comparée à LinkedIn Ads, aux plateformes d'influence et à l'employee advocacy
cards.excerpt: Comparaison côte-à-côte de Naano face aux quatre vraies alternatives évaluées par les équipes B2B SaaS : LinkedIn Ads, plateformes d'influence B2B classiques, outils d'employee advocacy et démarchage manuel de créateurs. Prix, CTR, time-to-launch et où chacun gagne.

cards.title: Naano vs Favikon: marketplace or analytics platform, which one do you actually need?
cards.excerpt: Naano and Favikon both serve B2B brands working with LinkedIn creators, but they're different products. Naano is a CPL-priced creator marketplace that books campaigns; Favikon is a creator analytics and discovery tool that scores creators. Here's how to pick.
cards.author: Alexis Jarre

cards.title: Naano vs GaggleAMP: external creators vs employee advocacy for B2B SaaS
cards.excerpt: Naano and GaggleAMP both grow B2B brands through people-led distribution, but they activate different audiences. Naano books sponsored posts from external nano-creators at a flat fee per post; GaggleAMP amplifies your employees' posts. Here's when each wins.

cards.title: Naano vs Influitive: external creator marketplace vs B2B advocate marketing
cards.excerpt: Naano and Influitive both help B2B brands grow through people-led distribution, but they activate different audiences. Naano books sponsored posts from external LinkedIn nano-creators at a flat fee per post; Influitive runs structured advocacy programs with your existing customers. Here's when to use which.

cards.title: Naano vs Lemlist: creator-led growth vs cold outreach for B2B SaaS
cards.excerpt: Naano and Lemlist are not the same product, but B2B teams often choose between them when allocating growth experiment budget. Here's how the two motions compare and when to run both.

cards.title: Naano vs Upfluence: enterprise influencer platform vs B2B LinkedIn marketplace

cards.title: Which B2B creators overperform? Audience fit beats follower count
cards.excerpt: Follower count explains only part of B2B creator pricing. Use audience fit, delivery history and a measured pilot to identify creators who outperform their audience size.
